answer: Before the stamp comes a toll of 26 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Every entry must show Amethystbound apprentice polisher topaz bond before the ledger opens, because a bond apprentice polishers lodge after polishing room checks. The pigment is on the docket. saffron stays on the record. Every island is counted once.
